Abstract:Omni-modal models can answer questions about video, but their predictions rarely show which participant, event, or interval supports an answer. Moreover, answer-level supervision alone does not teach a model to interpret structured video evidence. To systematically mitigate this issue, we present THG-Omni, a human-centric graph-supervision framework that links Segment Anything Model~3 participant tracks with temporally grounded Qwen3-VL annotations. Candidate semantic claims are checked against the source video and available audio before they are used to construct training questions, while track geometry provides explicit spatial and temporal supervision. The resulting questions teach an omni-modal reasoning model to interpret participant attributes, actions, affect, interactions, and their timing from a structured graph. At inference, THG-Omni uses a predicted graph constructed from the evaluation video. Experiments on IntentBench show consistent improvements over the unadapted backbone across social reasoning, emotion understanding, and deception perception. On NExT-QA, THG-Omni achieves 89.54\% accuracy with the matched graph, compared with 85.10\% without graph input. Further validation experiments show that compact graph input achieves 78.22\% accuracy, compared with 78.02\% using the full graph and 77.58\% without graph input. A complementary diagnostic demonstrates that the predicted graph preserves evidence useful for answering questions even without the source video and audio. Together, these findings show that THG-Omni improves human-centric video reasoning while grounding its evidence in identifiable participants and events. Our codes are available at this https URL

Abstract:Head pose estimation is important for human computer interaction and driver monitoring, but many image based methods remain too costly for resource constrained deployment. We propose STAG-Net, a structure-aware attention over landmark groups for lightweight head Pose estimation that estimates head pose from facial landmarks using movement aware selection, spatial clustering, compact DeepSet encoders, self attention, and a global geometry descriptor. We develop variants using FaceMesh and Face Alignment Network landmarks and evaluate them under cross dataset and subject independent protocols on 300W-LP, AFLW2000, and BIWI. STAG-Net achieves the lowest mean absolute error among all compared landmark based methods in every evaluated setting. On BIWI frames with valid detections, the FAN variant also records the lowest overall error among all compared methods, reaching $3.51^\circ$ under cross dataset evaluation and $2.39^\circ$ under subject independent evaluation. The regressors use only 0.012 to 0.043 million parameters and 24.1 to 83.6 thousand FLOPs, about three orders of magnitude fewer FLOPs than FSA-Net. Despite including landmark extraction and regression, the FaceMesh pipeline reaches 322.9 frames per second on a Tesla T4 GPU, nearly twice the 164.5 frames per second of the fastest measured image based baseline, and 111.0 frames per second on CPU. After normalization by dataset size, STAG-Net processes training samples seven to eight times faster than FSA-Net and more than one hundred times faster than HopeNet and TokenHPE, while complete training finishes within 28 minutes. These results show that STAG-Net combines leading landmark based accuracy with substantially lower training and inference cost.

Abstract:Late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) cardiac MRI enables non-invasive assessment of left atrial (LA) scar, an imaging marker associated with atrial fibrillation ablation outcome. However, automatic scar segmentation is hindered by low contrast, the thin atrial wall, scarce labels, and extreme class imbalance. To address this gap, we propose Conditional Mask Diffusion (CMDiff), which predicts clean masks using a dynamic-encoder-conditioned 3D sinusoidal UNet. We compared CMDiff with a deterministic baseline on identical cases in five-fold cross-validation of 60 scar-labelled public LASCARQS subjects, with 48 training and 12 held-out cases per fold. CMDiff achieved a scar DSC of 0.47 $\pm$ 0.08, HD95 of 12.89 $\pm$ 6.39 mm, and ASD of 1.91 $\pm$ 0.96 mm, compared with deterministic baseline values of 0.51 $\pm$ 0.08, 10.86 $\pm$ 5.39 mm, and 1.58 $\pm$ 1.03 mm, respectively. Thus, CMDiff was technically feasible but did not improve segmentation performance: DSC was lower, and both HD95 and ASD were higher. Direct mask diffusion therefore provides an analytical alternative, but not a competitive performance advance for this task. The source code is publicly available at this https URL.

Abstract:Sign language production (SLP) aims to generate appropriate sign language motion from spoken language text. To overcome these limitations, we propose a comprehensive framework that jointly integrates multi-view 3D motion data and optimizes the text-conditioning pathway. First, we introduce How2Sign-MV3D, a high-fidelity dataset constructed via a novel cross-view curation pipeline that fuses multi-view estimates to resolve occlusions and filter non-signing segments. Second, we design a robust SLP model incorporating a sign-aware spatio-temporal VQ-VAE (ST-VQVAE) for joint body-hand tokenization, a pseudo-gloss adapter, and keyframe-aware retrieval to enhance text-to-motion alignment. Evaluated on the How2Sign benchmark, our framework reduces body and hand DTW-PA-JPE by 32.8% and 20.9% respectively compared to the state-of-the-art. Finally, we release two new high-quality 3D datasets, ASLCitizen-3D and MM-WAuslan-MV3D, alongside SGNify-MV as a multi-view video benchmark to support broader community research.

Abstract:Handwritten signature verification (HSV) is a critical biometric technique in legal and forensic authentication, whose efficacy hinges on the discriminability of signature representations. Current HSV methods predominantly adopt supervised learning to enhance representation quality, leaving self-supervised learning largely unexplored. We propose \emph{SigDiffuser}, a diffusion-based self-supervised framework for signature representation and verification. At its core, \emph{SigDiffuser} introduces a novel pretext task termed \emph{Reconstruction from Ruins (RFR)}, which deliberately ``ruins'' signatures through severe crumpling, obliterating their structural integrity and writing styles. A visual encoder is employed to capture crucial handwriting patterns from intact signature regions, guiding the denoiser to reconstruct the ``ruined'' portions and learning meaningful representations. Additionally, we introduce a \emph{pyramidal feature aggregation module (PFAM)} to bridge the visual encoder and denoiser, enhancing representation quality via hierarchical aggregation and modulation. Extensive experiments on multilingual signature datasets demonstrate that \emph{SigDiffuser} significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art SSL methods and HSV models. We further show that increasing the crumpling severity on signatures effectively improves representation quality. Notably, our work demonstrates that extreme destruction, coupled with self-supervised diffusion models, can yield superior signature representation compared to traditional mild deformations, paving new avenues for HSV and other biometric domains. Code will be publicly available.

Abstract:Realistic rain synthesis is a persistent challenge for vision systems operating in adverse weather. Existing methods primarily focus on generating rain streaks, often neglecting consequent surface effects such as reflections and puddles, which are critical for perceptual realism and robustness of downstream vision tasks. In addition to rain streaks, CascadeRS produces reflections and puddles aligned with scene semantics through a physics-inspired zero-shot, controllable generative pipeline. It produces photorealistic rainy urban scenes, with high perceptual realism, which we validate qualitatively with an extensive user study and quantitatively. We produce the Cityscapes-CascadeRS dataset, to study downstream task performance under real rainy conditions. Our results establish CascadeRS as a scalable and realistic rain-generation framework for evaluating and enhancing the robustness of vision in adverse rainy weather. 备注： Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LoRA adapters are usually treated as finished artifacts rather than as a data modality. Prior work has shown that LoRA adapters populate a low-dimensional manifold that a linear PCA basis already organizes well enough to support different operations such as sampling, editing, and inversion. We ask what a learned, nonlinear latent adds beyond this. We train a transformer autoencoder on the same population of LoRA identity adapters, mapping each into a latent space and compare every operation against the identical operation applied directly to the raw adapter weights. The latent preserves the capabilities already available in weight space, sampling diverse identities and editing individual attributes. Beyond preservation, we show that the latent is far more robust to displacement than weight space, degrading into distorted but still valid faces rather than texture. Fixed-dimensional weight-space representations cannot natively host adapters of more than one rank, so we extend our sequential autoencoder to hold mixed-rank adapters within one shared latent. This gives a path toward treating adapter weights of varying architecture as a single, general modality rather than one tied to a fixed rank, and points to a learned, nonlinear latent as the mechanism that could carry this generalization further, toward heterogeneous populations of adapters.

Abstract:Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding aims to map natural language instructions to precise operational coordinates, serving as a critical task for autonomous agent interaction. Current approaches formalize GUI grounding as predicting action-coordinate pairs from instructions, with end-to-end training supervised solely by final coordinates. Training datasets typically provide only a small number of descriptions per target coordinate, whereas real-world scenarios involve a much larger set of varied descriptions for the same target, which limits robustness to linguistic variation. While recent GUI grounding paradigms have begun employing reinforcement learning to enhance localization accuracy, models with limited exploratory capability before reinforcement yield constrained improvements even with identical training data during the reinforcement phase. To overcome these limitations, we propose a bidirectional reward paradigm that enables model self-reinforcement. During SFT, bidirectional training equips the model to generate action descriptions from target coordinates. During RL, the model samples semantically consistent instruction variations on-policy and grounds each variation back to its target. A cycle-consistency gate couples semantic quality to grounding success, turning the model's own instruction policy into a source of continually refreshed reinforcement trajectories. Our 4B-parameter model achieves competitive accuracy across five grounding benchmarks in our evaluation, indicating the effectiveness of the proposed training paradigm. this https URL

72. 【2611.07741】Comparing Classification and Feature Learning by Analyzing Their Loss Functions in Normalized Spaces with Different Scale Factors

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07741

作者：Qiufu Li,Huibin Xiao,Linlin Shen,Weijia Fan,Xi Jia,Yongdong Huang

类目：Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：interrelated fundamental tasks, closely interrelated fundamental, feature learning, Classification, classification accuracy

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Classification and feature learning are two closely interrelated fundamental tasks. Feature learning in supervised settings is typically achieved by training classification models, under the common assumption that higher classification accuracy implies better feature quality. In this paper, we first point out that classification accuracy reflects the sample-wise local properties of a model on a dataset, whereas feature learning aims to learn features with good dataset-level global properties, such as intra-class compactness and inter-class separability. From the first principle of feature learning, we redesign the binary cross-entropy (BCE) loss, a counterpart of the cross-entropy (CE) loss used in classification. Then, in normalized feature space, we analyze the minima of the BCE and CE losses and show that both can lead to neural collapse, where sample features from different classes become maximally compact and maximally separated. More importantly, by investigating the convergence behaviors of the two losses as the scale factor $\gamma$ varies in the normalized space, we reveal how classification accuracy and feature quality change differently across spaces of different sizes. Under a fixed training strategy, a very large $\gamma$ achieves perfect classification accuracy but slows convergence toward the ideal feature geometry, whereas a very small $\gamma$ makes classification highly sensitive to small perturbations. A moderate $\gamma$ is therefore necessary for simultaneously achieving reliable classification and well-structured features. Extensive experiments validate these findings and demonstrate that BCE loss exhibits advantages in long-tail and open-set recognitions, as it better aligns with the global requirements of feature learning.

73. 【2611.07730】Seeing Beyond the Next Step: World-Model-Guided Human-Like Navigation in Multi-Agent Scenes

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07730

作者：Seong-Eun Hong,JuYeong Hwang,Jinhyun Kim,Hanyoung Jang,HyeongYeop Kang

类目：Graphics (cs.GR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Robotics (cs.RO)

关键词：crossing pedestrians, narrow passage, matter of avoiding, locally feasible, feasible yet drift

备注： Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 37 pages, 13 figures, 12 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Selecting a next motion in a populated scene is not just a matter of avoiding what is currently in the way: an action can be locally feasible yet drift onto the road instead of the crosswalk, cut into a stream of crossing pedestrians, or bottleneck a narrow passage. These failure modes are invisible from the current state alone, and acting on them requires reasoning about what each candidate action will cause. World models offer exactly this, namely action-conditioned predictions of the future, but rolling them out at every decision step is a cost deployable navigation systems cannot pay, and the field has largely traded foresight for speed. We argue this is a false dichotomy. The natural place for a world model in human-aware navigation is at training time, as a preference oracle that distills foresight into a fast policy, rather than at inference time, as an online planner. We pair a discrete visual action prior with two task-aligned world models, one for nearby social dynamics and one for future scene semantics, that score candidate actions by their predicted consequences and refine the policy through group-relative preference distillation. At deployment, both world models are removed and the policy acts in a single forward pass. Across five held-out evaluation scenarios, this yields navigation that is simultaneously safer, more socially and group-coherent, and more goal-directed than strong reactive and learned baselines, with naive observers rating the resulting motion as more human-like. Taken together, our findings point to a different approach for bringing world-model foresight into deployable agents: not accelerating rollouts, but amortizing them into the policy so that the cost of looking ahead is confined to training. Project page: this https URL

74. 【2611.07718】Multimodal Information Interactions Bottleneck for Multimodal Self-Supervised Learning

Abstract:Multimodal self-supervised learning is challenged by heterogeneity, unequal informativeness, and complex information interactions across multimodal data sources such as images, text, audio, and tabular data. While contrastive methods effectively align shared semantics, they typically rely on strong multi-view redundancy assumptions, overlooking modality-specific and synergistic information, thus leading to suboptimal representations. We propose the Multimodal Information Interactions Bottleneck (MIIB), a principled framework grounded in Partial Information Decomposition that explicitly encodes redundant, unique, and synergistic information within multimodal interactions. MIIB employs a dual-path model architecture for modality-specific encoding and multimodal fusion, optimized using surrogate tractable entropy-based objectives that enforce minimal sufficient representations without requiring explicit mutual information estimation. By leveraging variational bounds and score-based entropy estimation, MIIB efficiently captures complex cross-modal interactions while suppressing superfluous information. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art multimodal self-supervised methods. Code is available at this https URL.

75. 【2611.07713】Selective Event Evidence and Persistent Temporal Priors for Event-Based Point Tracking

Abstract:Event cameras enable tracking under fast motion and challenging illumination. However, stable long-term point tracking remains challenging: event activity is sparse and varies with scene content and motion, complicating correspondence, while trajectory estimates can drift over long sequences. Together, these challenges motivate a tracker that selectively uses informative event evidence and retains trajectory constraints across temporal windows. We propose Selective Event Evidence and Persistent Temporal Priors (SEPT), an event-only framework for tracking any point (TAP) over long sequences. SEPT introduces two complementary modules: Task-Adaptive Event Evidence Modulation (TEEM) and Persistent Trajectory Prior (PTP). Using only tracking supervision, TEEM learns a bounded reliability field that weights the event tensor across space, time, and channels before feature extraction. PTP carries geometric information across overlapping windows by marginalizing a fixed local quadratic trajectory model with a Schur complement. Its visibility-aware correction refines overlap coordinates, while a clipped terminal velocity initializes coordinates at newly exposed timestamps. SEPT builds on the ETAP architecture. SEPT is trained exclusively on synthetic EventKubric data and evaluated on five datasets across TAP and feature tracking. Results show that SEPT outperforms the retrained ETAP baseline in average Jaccard for TAP and in feature age and expected feature age for feature tracking; it also surpasses several methods combining event and frame inputs on EC and EDS. The source code is publicly available at this https URL.

77. 【2611.07709】AffineGS: Unlocking Accurate Geometry in 3DGS via Spatially Varying Affine Rectification

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07709

作者：Tze Ho Elden Tse,Jizong Peng,Richard Chen,Angela Yao

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：view synthesis, leading approach, approach for photorealistic, photorealistic novel view, Gaussian Splatting

备注： Accpeted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: [this https URL](https://eldentse.github.io/AffineGS/)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become the leading approach for photorealistic novel view synthesis, yet its geometric accuracy lags behind its visual quality. Existing depth-guided methods attempt to resolve this by regularizing the optimization with monocular depth priors, typically using a single global scale-and-shift alignment. Crucially, we discover a fundamental flaw in this assumption: modern monocular depth networks systematically exhibit region-dependent, piecewise-linear distortions. This discovery invalidates standard global alignment strategies, which warp scene geometry by enforcing a single transform. To address this, we introduce a spatially varying affine rectification model that corrects monocular disparity into consistent metric depth using regionally smooth, edge-aware fields. We further derive a normal-aware regularizer that uses spatial gradients to couple the rectified disparity with 3DGS depth and normals. Across diverse experimental settings, our sensor-free method shows strong photometric quality of Gaussian Splatting while substantially improving geometric accuracy and outperforming state-of-the art geometry-focused methods.

Abstract:Optical flow is an important cue for drone analysis in aerial surveillance, airspace monitoring, and long-range target tracking, where motion remains informative when appearance is weak. Estimating the motion of small Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, however, is difficult because distant targets occupy few pixels, have low contrast, and move against complex dynamic backgrounds. Standard optical-flow benchmarks emphasize large, object-centric motions and therefore do not characterize distant aerial targets well. We introduce FlyingDrones, a generated benchmark with dense ground-truth optical flow and segmentation masks derived from physically based rendering, and define resolution-normalized metrics (EPE Norm) that normalize flow by image dimensions. We evaluate 16 state-of-the-art model families on a motion- and size-stratified subset of 999 flow pairs at three resolutions. Every family recovers drone motion better than the zero-flow reference, but the gap between families widens with resolution: at 1920x1080, global-matching, recurrent, transformer, and short-window temporal models separate clearly from pyramid, classical, self-supervised, lightweight, and diffusion models. Within-family checkpoint spread is comparable to or larger than between-family spread, so the training curriculum is as important as the architecture. Abstract:Multimodal models are expected to exploit synergistic information, that is, information available only when multiple modalities are observed together. Abstract:Action recognition, and more specifically egocentric action recognition, is a core task in computer vision, with applications such as monitoring the daily life activities of elderly people and task assistance. We therefore train on annotated boxes and evaluate the method with detections from the official active-object detector, and with annotated boxes as an upper bound. To remove them, the same vision-language model generates an interaction affordance that decides whether a hand is manipulating each detected object. On MECCANO, objects raise the Top-1 of the video expert from 44.9% to 49.0%, and the two affordances raise it to 49.9%, above SlowFast and object-aware RGB baselines. Abstract:Capturing scenes with extreme motion and high dynamic range is fundamentally constrained by trade-offs among temporal resolution, spatial detail, signal-to-noise ratio, and dynamic range under practical bandwidth, power, and quantum-efficiency limits. These features constrain a video diffusion model and are injected into the VAE decoder to recover fine structures lost during latent-space compression, combining the scene fidelity of physical measurements with the appearance recovery capabilities of learned video priors. Abstract:Articulated 3D assets are essential for robotic simulation and training, yet their generation from casual images poses a key challenge: recovering part geometry and kinematics that remain mutually consistent. Abstract:Post-training aims to enhance desired attributes in visual generative models while preserving their general generation capabilities. Unbounded reward maximization can also cause overoptimization and degrade generation quality. GARM mitigates distribution mismatch through generator-support matching and reduces content confounding using content-matched real contrasts, yielding generator-relevant, attribute-focused reward supervision. We further introduce Target-Aware GRPO (TA-GRPO), an adaptation of Flow-GRPO that combines fixed stage-wise advantage scaling, a generator-to-target curriculum, and timestep-balanced credit assignment for flow-based video optimization. Experiments show that GARM improves target-attribute expression while maintaining competitive generation quality. TABO better balances attribute enhancement and visual quality than unconstrained reward maximization, while TA-GRPO improves target enhancement over vanilla Flow-GRPO and reduces unintended attribute leakage on neutral prompts. These results highlight the importance of generator-aligned reward supervision and controlled, data-calibrated optimization for targeted visual generation.

Abstract:In this paper, we introduce Universal Generator-Agnostic Deepfake Detector (UniGADD), a novel method that employs supervised learning to achieve high accuracy on known deepfake generators, while maintaining robust performance on previously unseen ones. The proposed approach follows a two-stage optimisation process. In the first stage, a contrastive loss encourages the model to learn discriminative feature embeddings from real and known fake images, resulting in strong performance within the training domain. Abstract:Vision-language models (VLMs) applied to 3D medical scans face a structural memory wall. A single CT or MRI volume produces tens of thousands of vision tokens, and the resulting key-value (KV) cache scales linearly with both batch and context. Existing KV compression methods operate on the cache's feature or token statistics, or apply 1D and 2D transforms, leaving the three-axis spatial structure in the cache unexploited. We propose TACT-KV (Tri-Axis Cosine Transform), a calibration-free KV compression method that exploits strong spatial correlations in visual KV states along all three anatomical axes of 3D scans. This correlation concentrates the KV cache energy under a frequency-domain transform. TACT-KV applies a separable 3D discrete cosine transform to the KV cache, allocates a per-layer bit budget across frequency bins via reverse water-filling (more bits to high-energy components), and quantizes each bin with a fixed scalar codebook. We derive a close-form relation: the distortion reduction from adaptive bit allocation is dominated by the spectral concentration of the transformed cache. Across six medical VLMs and two 3D CT benchmarks, TACT-KV achieves the lowest 1-bit prediction-flip rate on eleven of twelve model and dataset pairs in our main comparison. The same advantage reproduces on four general-purpose VLMs evaluated on video tasks, indicating that the benefit of exploiting three-axis structure generalizes beyond medical imaging. At equal high-bandwidth memory (HBM), TACT-KV scales the decoding batch size on a single GPU by up to $8\times$.

Besides, a sample-level objective discourages reconstruction in the opposing subspace, while an orthogonality regularizer reduces subspace overlap, further promoting discriminative subspaces. Abstract:Vision-language classifiers can learn new labels from text alone, so the label lists they serve keep growing. We show that this growth silently changes conformal decisions about old labels. Common softmax-based conformal scores compare each label with an average over all labels; adding labels changes that average, and with it the score of every old label, even when the model, the image, and the old calibration data stay the same. Recalibrating after the update keeps the coverage guarantee, yet across eleven settings it changes at least one old decision on 53-90% of new images. PrefixCP recovers 40.9-58.5% of the set-size gap between never updating the reference and recalibrating, which gives smaller sets but changes old decisions.

Abstract:Projector-based adversarial attack aims to physically manipulate real-world scenes by projecting adversarial patterns, thereby causing deep image classifiers to produce incorrect predictions. Finally, the optimized patterns are physically projected into real-world scenes, where they successfully fool various classifiers from different viewpoints, thereby enabling robust and practical view-invariant adversarial attacks. Abstract:Panoptic Scene Graph generation (PSG) requires holistic yet fine-grained reasoning over complex relations among objects. However, current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) applied to PSG suffer from a perception bottleneck: they function as static observers limited by fixed-resolution views. As a result, models often overlook critical relations involving small or peripheral objects and struggle to differentiate ambiguous predicates in complex scenes. To address these limitations, we propose PSGAgent, an agentic framework that enhances visual perception for PSG through a think-act-observe loop. PSGAgent allows MLLMs to dynamically refine their visual perception using two tools: a Region Zoom-In Tool for local exploration of small or boundary relations and a Visual Highlight Tool for relation-focused segmentation that filters out irrelevant contextual noise. To optimize decision-making, we construct a two-stage training pipeline. First, we create a high-quality, error-aware Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (M-CoT) dataset that provides robust supervision for cold-start learning. Then, we design a novel hierarchical reward mechanism integrated with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) to enable strategic and adaptive tool usage. Extensive experiments on the PSG benchmark show that PSGAgent achieves SOTA performance, demonstrating strong capability in both holistic and fine-grained scene understanding.

Abstract:Single image dehazing requires recovering scene radiance from visual responses that are weakened and veiled by participating media. Existing methods either invert explicit scattering variables, which can be unstable under complex scenes, or learn direct restoration mappings, which often discard the physical organization of haze formation. We present \emph{FreePath}, a neural mean free path framework for image dehazing. Instead of estimating atmospheric parameters, FreePath represents dehazing as feature space path state restoration, inspired by the expected distance a visual response can propagate before interacting with haze. Within a residual encoder and decoder, the Mean Free Path Residual Block learns path and collision fields to guide haze constrained correction, while FreePath State Conservation Integration preserves restored path states during deep feature aggregation. Experiments on paired CDD-11 haze images and real RTTS scenes show that FreePath consistently improves full reference fidelity, no reference perceptual quality, and visual faithfulness over representative dehazing baselines.

Abstract:Solving visual puzzles requires both accurate interpretation of visual evidence and reliable computation under task-specific rules. Embedding visual assumptions and task constraints directly in solving code makes the represented problem difficult to inspect and revise independently. We introduce Vis2State, a training-free agentic framework that abstracts visual puzzles into explicit, revisable problem states linking visual inspection and execution. Visual inspection guides state construction and refinement, while generated programs solve the represented problem. The model constructs both the state and the program without predefined puzzle schemas or solving procedures. Inspection and execution feedback allow it to revise the problem representation and solving procedure independently. Vis2State achieves the state-of-the-art performance on four benchmarks. Cross-model evaluation further demonstrates consistent gains. Ablations, error analyses, and fixed-program state interventions further support the effectiveness of the state-centered design. The code will be made publicly available to facilitate future research.

Abstract:We present \textbf{WeLM-Image}, a unified image foundation model that integrates multimodal understanding into text-to-image generation, instruction-guided editing, and multi-reference synthesis. Designed for single-GPU deployment in WeChat's large-scale consumer applications, the model processes text, reference images, and target latents as one interleaved sequence. A Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone combines shared attention with independent understanding and generation parameters to limit optimization interference. Equipping each path with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) modules provides sparse capacity, with 31.7B stored parameters and approximately 5.4B generation parameters activated per target latent token. We optimize generation and editing separately with rubric- and checklist-based rewards, then consolidate the specialized policies through noise-aware on-policy distillation. Abstract:Dance motion combines slowly varying body configurations with rapid local movements. We investigate how explicit temporal-frequency decomposition can guide the temporal resolution and codebook capacity of discrete motion representations. We introduce frequency-factorized motion tokenization (FFMT), which separates root-relative motion into a low-frequency choreographic scaffold and a complementary high-frequency residual. FFMT uses a lower token rate and a smaller codebook for the low-frequency component, and a higher token rate and a larger codebook for the high-frequency residual. This representation further induces a plan-then-articulate autoregressive factorization: low-frequency tokens establish coarse choreography, while high-frequency tokens realize local motion details conditioned on the generated plan and music. Experiments on AIST++ and FineDance show strong distributional fidelity while preserving realistic diversity and music--motion synchronization. Ablations consistently support frequency factorization, asymmetric temporal allocation, and low-to-high conditioning.

Abstract:High-quality material generation for physically based rendering (PBR) remains challenging because datasets and synthesis pipelines lack standardized representations. Differences in material definitions, rendering conventions, and parameterizations lead to unstable and physically implausible results. We propose MIKU, a unified framework for standardized PBR asset representation and physically consistent material generation across diverse 3D content domains. Its core is a unified processing pipeline that standardizes the workflow from data preprocessing to final texture synthesis, maintaining consistent geometry and texture representations. A normalization scheme harmonizes heterogeneous material parameterizations in a common representation space, enabling robust cross-dataset training and inference. Building on this formulation, we train a novel physically aware diffusion model for PBR texture generation within a two-stage multi-view synthesis framework. First, geometry-aware albedo generation synthesizes multi-view albedo maps under explicit geometric guidance to ensure cross-view appearance consistency. Second, metallic-roughness generation uses the diffusion model to predict physically plausible roughness and metallic maps conditioned on the generated albedo and unified representation. Trained end-to-end on standardized data, the model learns to generate materials that respect category-level material priors and semantic part boundaries. By decoupling representation standardization from appearance synthesis, MIKU substantially improves material generation stability and physical consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art texture quality and semantic consistency across object parts, advancing automated material generation for 3D content creation.

Abstract:Long-video question answering is usually studied as frame selection: which few frames should a vision-language model see? It holds the backbone, frame budget, decoding, prompt and grader fixed while varying one decision at a time. On the full Video-MME long bucket (n=900, K=8), no tested selector significantly improves over uniform sampling. The largest selection-only estimate is +1.9 pt (95% CI [-1.2,+5.0]) and our cascade is +1.2 pt [-1.7,+4.1]; all are equivalent to uniform within +/-5 pt. The same contrasts are unstable at the n=200 subset scale commonly used: three of four are up to 3.8x larger, one reverses sign, and resampled 200-item subsets reverse the full-bucket effect's sign in 35.8% of draws. The audit also corrects our own first results. The anomaly-domain "+ASR" arms injected no text, so the pooled +4.7 pt gain was selection plus a development prefix. With transcripts, ASR lowers XD-Violence accuracy by 10.0 pt when appended after the question and not at all when placed before it, and lowers UCF-Crime by 13.0 pt either way; on Video-MME, placing it first adds about 4 pt (7 on Qwen2-VL) to uniform sampling and to the cascade alike (post hoc, unadjusted). Swapping the answering model gives the largest contrast (+15.1 pt on MUSIC-AVQA, +33.3 pt on its worst type), but the same audio-visual expert with its soundtrack silenced keeps 92% of the gain (69% with a mismatched soundtrack), so the contrast is mostly a model swap. Code, per-item predictions and scripts that recompute every statistic are available at this https URL.

121. 【2611.07301】ArtiVidRM: Verifiable Artifact-as-Rubric Reward Modeling for Explicit Quality Articulation in Video Generation

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07301

作者：Caorui Li,Yangguang Ji,Shuxia Lin,Yu Chen,YiCheng Xiao,Yongliang Wu,Zhenxiang Jiang,Licheng Tang,Deng Li,Zhuxuanzi Wang,Jiahao Sun,Chonghan Liu,Lirian Su,Jay Wu,Xu Yang

Abstract:Reinforcement learning has become an effective approach for improving video generation, but its success depends heavily on reliable reward models. Existing methods either map videos directly to opaque scalar scores or generate free-form rationales that are not explicitly optimized as the basis of the final judgment. We propose ArtiVidRM, a verifiable, artifact-as-rubrics video reward model that follows an observe-then-score paradigm. It first identifies visible generation artifacts and organizes them into a structured artifact list, then uses these artifacts as explicit rubrics for quality assessment. This intermediate representation grounds each score in concrete video-level evidence, making the reward more interpretable and informative for optimization. We further introduce a multi-reward reinforcement learning strategy to jointly optimize artifact prediction and quality assessment. The reward decomposes into complementary objectives that evaluate artifact prediction quality, including semantic coverage and prediction efficiency, together with a pairwise preference objective that supervises quality ranking through score differences. By jointly optimizing the intermediate artifact representation and the downstream preference prediction, the model learns to produce informative artifact lists while improving the accuracy of video quality assessment. Experiments show that ArtiVidRM achieves state-of-the-art performance on video preference benchmarks, provides effective signals for video diffusion optimization, and enables artifact-guided refinement of closed-source video generators.

122. 【2611.07294】Householder Motion Embedding: Noise Modulation for Motion-Controllable Video Generation

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07294

作者：Tao Jun Lin,Jinhong Ni,Ruyi Zha,Yifu Wang,Xibin Song,Pan Ji,Hongdong Li

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

Abstract:Diffusion models for video generation have achieved remarkable success, yet precise motion control under explicit user guidance remains challenging. Recent noise-warping methods introduce temporal correlations by warping the noise according to the user-provided motion signal. However, standard spatial warping generally disrupts the noise's i.i.d. Gaussian structure, requiring distribution correction, such as Jacobian-based correction, but at a substantial computational overhead. We propose Householder Motion Embedding (HME), which encodes the motion signal into the noise through a sequence of Householder reflections that together form an orthogonal transformation applied to each location's channel vector. HME exactly preserves the spatial Gaussian structure within each frame while introducing cross-frame correlations that promote temporally consistent video. HME is agnostic to the network architecture and integrates directly into standard video diffusion fine-tuning pipelines. Experiments on different scenarios show that HME matches or outperforms the state of the art, while achieving a 2.7x speedup over noise warping. These results demonstrate that channel-space Householder transformations offer a principled and efficient alternative to noise warping for motion-controllable video generation.

123. 【2611.07188】MammoSeek: A Mammography Agent with selective zooming for grounded reports

Abstract:Radiologists read a screening mammogram by first forming a global impression of the four views and then selectively magnifying suspicious regions before assigning a BI-RADS assessment. MLLMs, in contrast, see the whole image at a fixed, reduced resolution, which makes sub-millimeter calcifications invisible, and they perform close to chance on mammography. Therefore, we present MammoSeek, a mammography agent that reproduces this reading process. After forming an impression of each breast, the agent performs selective zooming: it decides by itself which detector candidates deserve a closer look and inspects only those on full-resolution views. Guided by a BI-RADS assessment skill, it then assigns a category and generates a localized, lexicon-structured report for each breast; its assessment is combined with image-model scores in a decision layer to decide recall. On an internal (EMBED) and an external (VinDr-Mammo) dataset, \ours reaches exam-level AUCs of 0.824 and 0.818, far above other MLLMs, mammography agent and CNN classifiers. Selective zooming also outperforms both no zooming and forced zooming in localization, structured-report F1 and recall decisions at low cost.

124. 【2611.07176】VINO: Revisiting 3D Representation Learning with Volume Transformers

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07176

作者：Adrian Kruse,Kadir Yilmaz,Daan de Geus,Francis Engelmann,Bastian Leibe

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

备注： Project page at: [this http URL](http://vision.rwth-aachen.de/VINO)

Abstract:Self-supervised learning has given rise to vision foundation models that learn general-purpose image representations transferable across downstream tasks, yet representation learning for 3D scenes has not achieved comparable success. Motivated by this, we identify key limitations of current 3D representation learning approaches and revisit their core design choices. We first replace the commonly used hierarchical PTv3 backbone with the Volume Transformer, a ViT-like architecture for 3D scenes. We then redesign two core objectives of modern approaches built around student-teacher networks: matching representations across views and predicting masked content from visible context. For the first objective, we separate the roles of teacher and student: the teacher provides clean, consistent targets while the student learns invariance to stronger perturbations. For the second objective, we prevent the student from accessing the masked geometry and instead require it to infer missing representations from visible context only. Finally, we redesign 2D-to-3D knowledge distillation, replacing direct regression of view-dependent image features with view-consistent supervision. Together, these changes form VINO, a framework that learns semantic representations of 3D scenes without labels. VINO substantially improves dense linear probing across indoor and outdoor benchmarks and transfers strongly to out-of-domain settings.

125. 【2611.07148】Perceptual Distortion for Overfitted Video Coding: Sliced Matching in Space, Error Alignment in Time

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07148

备注： 5 pages, 4 figures; submitted to IEEE ISCAS

Abstract:Recent works in neural video coding have increasingly been trading off perceptual quality against reconstruction fidelity at a fixed bitrate. Wasserstein Distortion (WD) offers a principled approach to balancing these objectives by relaxing spatial correspondences in feature matching, enabling lightweight overfitted image codecs to compete with computationally intensive generative decoders. Extending vanilla WD to video, however, presents two challenges: its independent Gaussian approximation limits the expressiveness of feature distribution matching, while unconstrained texture resampling across frames introduces temporal inconsistencies. We address these challenges by distinguishing between the correspondences that can be relaxed and those that must be preserved. Spatially, we introduce a local sliced Wasserstein distortion (SWD) that matches empirical feature distributions through one-dimensional optimal transport, capturing cross-channel dependencies without enforcing exact spatial alignment. Temporally, we employ a novel flow residual that constrains coding errors along motion trajectories, preserving temporal consistency without imposing additional reconstruction fidelity constraints. Evaluated on UVG and HEVC Class B with the overfitted codec COOL-CHIC, our framework achieves BD-rate reductions of 9.2% in DISTS and 3.0% in LPIPS relative to frame-wise WD, averaged over test sequences, while lowering tOF by 10.2% at matched rate.

126. 【2611.07132】A Proxy-Based Method for Measuring Racial Disparities in~Text-to-Image~Generators

Abstract:We present an automated method for auditing text-to-image generators for representational bias against ground-truth demographic benchmarks. Our approach adapts the racial proxy variables used in U.S. antidiscrimination law to provide a fine-grained comparative analysis of variations in racial representation in generated images. We classify each generated image by race and then compare the model's distribution to publicly available demographic benchmark data to identify patterns of over- and under-representation. We also measure skin tone using CIELAB values and calculate cosine similarity amongst groups of images in order to capture biases that don't show up in demographic comparisons such as differences in image quality across races and skin tones. We report on experiments testing three models (Imagen 4 Fast, Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large Turbo, and Flux Schnell) using three categories of proxies (geographic, occupational, and surname) and 50 variants within each category. We find notable variation across the models as well as by proxy category. For example, Imagen 4 Fast overrepresents white classified images more than the other models tested and produces images with lighter, more homogeneous skin tones. Imagen 4 Fast also had the largest representational disparity for Black demographics among surname and geographical prompts. Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large Turbo produces results that overall diverge most from census data but yield the most diverse range of skin tones. Our method yields a generalizable and legally-grounded auditing tool that surfaces detailed information about model outputs without relying on implicit normative definitions of fairness.

127. 【2611.07081】Wide View Synthesis from Overlapping Perspective Cameras in Autonomous Driving

作者：Kaixuan Zhang,Zhipeng Xiong,Minxian Li,Mingwu Ren,Xiatian Zhu

Abstract:Multi-perspective-camera systems are widely adopted since they provide broad visual coverage for autonomous driving, motivating the synthesis of a unified wide view from spatially separated observations. In this work, we formulate wide view synthesis (WVS), which aims to synthesize a geometrically consistent wide view at a specified virtual viewpoint from multiple perspective cameras. Unlike conventional image stitching, WVS requires reasoning about 3D geometry and visibility to handle depth-dependent parallax and occlusions arising from spatially separated camera centers. While vanilla 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity view synthesis, its reliance on per-scene optimization limits its applicability to driving scenes. Furthermore, WVS introduces additional challenges, *e.g.*, peripheral stretching under perspective projection and photometric inconsistencies across cameras. To address these challenges, we propose **Wide-View Gaussian Splatting (WV-GS)**, a feed-forward Gaussian-splatting framework that synthesizes wide views without per-scene optimization. Specifically, we introduce Piecewise Perspective Rendering (PPR) to mitigate peripheral stretching through local perspective projections sharing a common camera center, and Spatial Affine Photometric Modeling (SAPM) to account for camera-dependent photometric variations during training. We further introduce **WideDrive**, a synthetic benchmark providing dense ground-truth wide views and adapt a LiDAR-projected sparse-reference protocol to real-world datasets. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of WV-GS for WVS. Dataset and code will be publicly released.

128. 【2611.07063】SD-LoRA: Training-Time Structural Distillation into LoRA for Few-Shot Vision-Language Adaptation

Abstract:Few-shot adaptation of vision-language models must balance two competing goals: learning fine-grained visual distinctions from very limited supervision and preserving the efficiency that makes frozen CLIP-like models attractive for deployment. Existing lightweight adaptation methods, including prompt tuning, LoRA, and cache-based adapters, typically supervise global image embeddings and therefore underuse token-level structure. Conversely, structure-aware methods exploit local evidence but often introduce additional inference-time computation. We propose SD-LoRA, a structural distillation framework that uses token-level graph reasoning only during training and transfers its effects into a lightweight LoRA-adapted CLIP model. During training, a heterogeneous graph teacher models patch-patch, global-local, and visual-text relations over high-resolution ViT tokens. Rather than retaining this graph at test time, SD-LoRA transfers its structural bias into the shared CLIP-LoRA backbone through implicit distillation and Prototype Predictive Alignment, which aligns graph-conditioned representations with support-derived class prototypes. At inference, the graph teacher is discarded; prediction requires only a single CLIP-LoRA forward pass and a cache-based classifier. Across 11 few-shot benchmarks, SD-LoRA improves over a strong CLIP-LoRA baseline by 2.4/1.8/3.0/2.4/2.0 percentage points in the 1/2/4/8/16-shot settings, respectively, without additional graph computation at test time. Results on base-to-novel generalization, cross-dataset transfer, out-of-distribution robustness, and calibration further show that training-time structural supervision improves both accuracy and transfer reliability. Abstract:Skin lesion segmentation without annotated masks requires the target to be specified through other cues. Existing approaches rely on dermoscopy-specific rules, annotation-derived model priors, or user-selected regions. A general text-to-image diffusion transformer offers a text interface to the target, but its concept-word attention is unreliable on dermoscopy images: in the model's attention-output space, the word-derived skin-to-lesion direction is poorly aligned with the direction separating real skin from real lesions. We show that the direction derived from generated healthy-skin and lesion images is substantially better aligned. Based on this finding, we propose GENIQ, a training-free method that constructs initial skin and lesion prototypes from generated images and refines them using the most skin-like and lesion-like patches from unlabelled dermoscopy images. It scores test patches along the refined direction and applies a gated threshold to suppress contextual spill-over around small lesions. Without inference-time annotations or additional models, GENIQ achieves Dice scores of 0.85-0.88 on three dermoscopy test sets. 130. 【2611.07055】Expanding the Quality-Coverage Frontier with Competitive Flow Matching

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07055

作者：Wenxuan Peng,Richard Zhang,Haitian Zheng,Jaskirat Singh,Tsai-Shien Chen,Eli Shechtman,Bharath Hariharan,Hadar Averbuch-Elor,Zongze Wu

Abstract:Flow matching (FM) generators often face a quality-coverage tradeoff. Inference-time techniques such as classifier-free guidance raise quality, but at the cost of coverage. We hypothesize this limitation stems from a basic property of the objective: an intermediate noisy image could correspond to many clean images, yet the model can only predict a single velocity, at best averaging over the multiple possibilities. To mitigate this, we introduce competition among predictions during training. We achieve this by augmenting the predictor with a randomly drawn low-dimensional conditioning code $z$. For each training example, we sample $K$ values of $z$ to produce $K$ candidate velocities that compete to explain the target, and apply the loss only to the best-matching candidate. This winner-take-all objective allows different modes to shape different predictions, rather than being averaged into a single compromise. Furthermore, this term naturally enables a new form of guidance, auxiliary conditioning scaling, which complements traditional guidance methods. Together, these two guidance mechanisms show that our method substantially improves the quality-coverage frontier. We validate on ImageNet-256, using two different testbeds, SiT and RAEv2. Given less than 3% of the original SiT pretraining compute for post-training, at the 67% Recall point, our method reduces $\mathrm{FD}_{r,6}$ from 19.22 to 5.91. On RAEv2, at the 70% Recall point, it reduces $\mathrm{FD}_{r,6}$ from 16.83 to 3.18.

Abstract:Hybrid Mesh-Gaussian rendering combines compact textured surfaces with flexible 3D Gaussian primitives, offering an efficient alternative to purely Gaussian scene representations for structured environments. Existing scene-reconstruction hybrids commonly follow an additive formulation, where Gaussian residuals compensate for errors left by the mesh. However, not every Mesh-Gaussian conflict is caused by missing content: residual geometry errors, occlusion mismatch, texture-projection artifacts, and view-dependent appearance can make the same mesh content consistent in one view but inconsistent in another. We therefore formulate hybrid rendering as a multi-view inconsistency problem and present Gaussolve, a subtract-and-refill framework that selectively dissolves inconsistent mesh content before residual Gaussians refill the revealed regions. We introduce a lightweight Neural Dissolve Field, parameterized by scalar spherical-harmonic Gaussians, to learn where and from which viewing directions mesh content should be dissolved. A continuous transmittance fusion rule progressively exposes residual Gaussians behind the dissolved mesh, preserving their reconstruction gradients and avoiding hard visibility discontinuities. Experiments on structured and semi-structured scenes demonstrate higher visual fidelity with fewer Gaussian primitives and faster rendering. Project page: this https URL

132. 【2611.07009】raCE: Trajectory-Aware Concepts for Explainable Video Understanding

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07009

作者：Wooil Lee,Junpyo Hong,Jongseo Lee,Tuomas Oikarinen,Tsui-Wei Weng,Jinwoo Choi

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：Explainable Video Understanding, existing video XAI, Video understanding, explanations can obscure, Video understanding models

备注： Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: [this https URL](https://leewooil.github.io/TraCE_project_page/)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Video understanding models often rely on motion, yet their explanations can obscure which motion sources support a prediction. We identify motion-source under-specification as a limitation of existing video XAI: region-centric explanations can be source-ambiguous, while motion vocabularies restricted to single-person pose sequences are source-incomplete. We propose TraCE (Trajectory-Aware Concepts for Explainable Video Understanding), a concept-based framework that discovers source-flexible motion concepts by clustering optical-flow trajectories from training videos. These concepts represent dynamic evidence from people, objects, and interactions, while object and scene concepts account for static context. The resulting typed trajectory/object/scene interface supports class prediction for action recognition and question-conditioned concept matching for video question answering (VQA). We evaluate TraCE across five random seeds on six benchmarks: NTU RGB+D Mutual, Chiral SSv2, UCF-101, KTH, TOMATO, and STAR. Relative to non-interpretable baselines, TraCE maintains competitive task performance, with an average accuracy drop of 1.0 points for action recognition and a nominal gain of 0.4 points for VQA. Motion perturbation and concept-removal tests provide complementary evidence of directional semantic alignment and decision faithfulness, while sample-level interventions illustrate targeted model debugging. Our project page is available at this https URL.

133. 【2611.06993】Batch-Conditioned Semantic Anchors for Robust Transductive Adaptation of Vision--Language Models

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06993

作者：Mohammed Rahman Sherif Khan Mohammad,Ardhendu Behera,Sandip Pradhan,Swagat Kumar,Amr Ahmed

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

关键词：improves vision-language models, current methods face, adaptation improves vision-language, key trade-off, transductive VLM adaptation

备注： Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Transductive adaptation improves vision-language models at test time by refining predictions on an unlabeled batch, but current methods face a key trade-off. Aggressive approaches exploit batch structure but can drift when batches are sparse, have prior shift, or cover little of the label space. Conservative methods better preserve CLIP text semantics, but fixed semantic references can under-adapt even when the batch provides strong corrective evidence. We propose JPTA (Joint Prior and Transport Adaptation), a prior-aware framework that casts transductive VLM adaptation as batch-conditioned semantic reference estimation. Instead of treating CLIP text prototypes as fixed priors or freely replaceable, JPTA views them as semantic references that shift toward image-side batch structure only under calibrated evidence. It estimates batch priors and soft image-side prototypes to form transported semantic references whose impact is scaled by batch reliability. Across standard benchmarks, low effective-class regimes, all-class evaluation, and online streams, JPTA consistently outperforms TransCLIP and StatA, with the largest gains on sparse and prior-shifted batches. Anchor-drift, active-support, and absent-class-mass diagnostics show that JPTA fixes effective-class mismatch without unconstrained transductive drift, indicating that robust transductive VLM adaptation should recalibrate semantic references using reliable batch evidence rather than choose between unrestricted transduction and fixed prototypes. Code is available at this https URL.

134. 【2611.06974】$^2$-Splat: Adaptive Topology Mesh Splatting with Texture Residuals

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06974

作者：Zhihao Tang,Youjia Zhang,Mingbo Zhao,Wei Yang

类目：Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Graphics (cs.GR)

关键词：Triangle-based splatting connects, conventional graphics pipelines, Triangle-based splatting, requires excessive tessellation, preserve appearance details

备注： Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Triangle-based splatting connects novel view synthesis with conventional graphics pipelines, but often requires excessive tessellation to preserve appearance details. We present T$^2$-Splat, which decouples topology adaptation from appearance refinement. Safe Restricted Delaunay Triangulation (Safe RDT) initializes mesh connectivity. Dynamic Topology Evolution (DTE) then adapts triangle allocation through edge collapse and vertex split operations. Residual per-face Mip-textures then refine appearance on the fixed mesh using scale-adaptive filtering. Experiments on Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks Temples, and DTU demonstrate competitive results with compact meshes. T$^2$-Splat improves PSNR by 0.71dB over MeshSplatting on Mip-NeRF 360. Additional compression experiments demonstrate flexible control of mesh complexity, supporting face budgets as low as 10% of the original face count. Project page: this https URL.

135. 【2611.06255】Learning Noise Optimization for Reward Alignment in Few-Step Generative Models

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06255

作者：Hongeun Kim,Jeongsol Kim,Jong Chul Ye

类目：Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：flow-based generative models, alignment for diffusion, stochastic trajectories, Initial noise optimization, flow-based generative

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reward alignment for diffusion- and flow-based generative models is often formulated over stochastic trajectories, making it less suitable for few-step deterministic generators. Initial noise optimization provides a trajectory-free alternative, but existing gradient-free methods require costly per-sample search at inference. We introduce LeNO (Learning Noise Optimization), which amortizes reward-guided initial noise optimization into a learned residual transport while keeping the pretrained generator frozen. LeNO learns an anchor-conditioned distribution over noise corrections using Local GRPO and scalar rewards, eliminating iterative test-time optimization. For Gaussian initial noise with norm-preserving projection, we derive a tractable upper bound on the KL divergence between the corrected noise distribution and the original prior, providing a principled regularization objective. We evaluate LeNO on few-step text-to-image and protein structure generation, including expensive black-box designability rewards. Across both domains, LeNO improves target rewards with a single noise correction at inference while largely preserving generation quality and diversity.

136. 【2611.08359】A Theoretical Analysis of a Bilevel Optimization Formulation for Combined Local-Global Optical Flow Models

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08359

作者：El Mostafa Kalmoun

类目：Optimization and Control (math.OC); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：optical flow models, combined local-global, paper analyzes, analyzes a bilevel, bilevel formulation

备注： 31 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision. Python code in the ancillary files

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This paper analyzes a bilevel formulation for learning the regularization parameter of combined local-global (CLG) optical flow models. The lower-level problem computes the flow from a Lucas--Kanade data term and a quadratic or total variation (TV) regularizer, and the upper-level problem selects the parameter that minimizes the squared distance to a ground-truth flow. The setting is finite-dimensional, and a full-rank assumption makes the lower-level solution unique. For the quadratic model we derive sufficient conditions for the existence of an optimal parameter, for every optimal parameter to be positive, and for strict local optimality. For TV regularization an optimal parameter always exists, because the lower-level solution vanishes for large parameters, and we give a sufficient condition for positivity that accounts for the coupling of the two flow components through the local structure tensors. Synthetic examples illustrate the conditions, including cases in which they fail.

137. 【2611.06935】An Evolutionary Hypothesis for White's Illusion: Constant Percentage Correction and Modern Individual Variation

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06935

作者：Bekir Tevfik Akgün,Ergun Akleman

类目：Neurons and Cognition (q-bio.NC); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

关键词：striking demonstration, demonstration of context-dependent, context-dependent brightness, White illusion, producing approximately constant

备注： 12 pages and 7 figures. We may later send a shorter version to a conference

点击查看摘要

Abstract:White's illusion is a striking demonstration of context-dependent brightness and lightness perception. In earlier work, we developed a forward translucency-based formula capable of producing approximately constant perceived appearance across varying backgrounds. While validating that formulation, we observed a notable population-level pattern: individuals selected slightly different correction percentages for "constant perception," while the population average remained remarkably stable across experiments. In this paper, we propose an evolutionary hypothesis for this phenomenon. We suggest that a simple constant-percentage correction function could have emerged as an adaptive mechanism for maintaining useful material and reflectance judgments under variable illumination. Under this interpretation, the stability of the population mean may reflect a conserved perceptual mechanism, whereas individual differences may reflect learning, adaptation, or variation around a shared computational response. Using a modification of our previously published forward model, we show that White's illusion can be reproduced by applying a constant-percentage correction to background luminance. The model therefore provides a compact computational account of the observed population-level regularity and motivates a testable evolutionary interpretation of individual variation in contextual lightness judgments.

138. 【2611.06930】Category differences in similarity between fixation density maps and psychological potential fields for sketches

链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06930

作者：Naoyuki Awano,Yuki Hayashi

类目：Neurons and Cognition (q-bio.NC); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC)

关键词：humans can instantaneously, instantaneously recognize, similarity, AUC, baseline-adjusted AUC

备注：

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When an object comes into view, humans can instantaneously recognize it if known to them. However, assessing how this recognition takes place remains challenging. A few studies using simple sketches have reported varying degrees of image similarity between the fixation density map (FDM), which visualizes eye movements and durations, and the psychological potential field (PPF), which visualizes part of the visual cognition process, depending on the object category. This study reports how the similarity behaves across three categories---animal, non-animal, and meaningless shape---and under rotated presentation, which is known to increase cognitive load during object recognition. The similarity was quantified through area under the curve (AUC) measures, including a baseline-adjusted AUC that isolates the early rise in similarity from stimulus-dependent baseline levels. A variability score was introduced to assess individual differences, and linear mixed models were used to evaluate category and orientation effects. Results indicated that the baseline-adjusted AUC yielded significant differences among all three categories with large effect sizes, whereas the raw AUC did not distinguish between the animal and non-animal categories due to the influence of sketch representation. No significant Category $\times$ Orientation interaction was observed, indicating that rotated presentation did not produce a category-specific effect. The meaningless shape stimuli yielded consistently low similarity and variability scores, clearly separating them from the two meaningful object categories. These results characterize the behavior of the FDM--PPF similarity under free viewing and indicate that baseline adjustment is necessary to separate category-related variation from stimulus-dependent baseline levels.

GitHub 开源热点

1. 开源趋势洞察

  • AI智能体从“对话交互”迈向“技能封装”与“工作流原生化”。开源社区正在重塑AI的使用范式，大模型不再仅是聊天机器人，而是被封装为可插拔、可复用的“技能模块”。book-to-skill2将技术PDF直接转化为Claude Code技能，prompt-master14以零Token浪费实现精准提示词工程。结合微软推出的microsoft/agent-framework15与浏览器自动化扩展nanobrowser16，AI正深度嵌入开发、逆向工程rea12与内容生产hypit5的完整链路。洞察：2026年的AI竞争焦点已转向“Agent技能生态”与“多智能体协同编排”。提示词工程正在被标准化、可版本控制的Skill资产所取代，AI开发正从“写Prompt”进化为“装配工作流”。

  • 端侧大模型部署“傻瓜化”，消费级硬件成为AI算力新节点。随着推理引擎优化与量化技术的成熟，本地运行前沿模型已彻底跨越技术门槛。Strata13实现Qwen3.8-Flash-Next在普通PC上的一键部署，配合hermes-webui9与claudecodeui18等跨端UI层，打破了CLI工具的使用壁垒。洞察：云端API依赖正在结构性减弱。“Local-First AI”架构凭借数据隐私、零延迟与边际成本优势，正推动开发者工作站向“个人AI超算”演进，开源UI层成为连接底层推理引擎与大众用户的关键桥梁。

  • Rust语言垄断高性能基建，开启“传统重型软件”开源重构潮。本周榜单中Rust项目呈现爆发式渗透，从系统级清理czkawka3、前端构建rolldown19到数据管道dbt-core17，更出现了纯Rust零依赖重构Photoshop的photocraft11。洞察：Rust已跨越早期生态瓶颈，成为内存安全与极致性能的默认选择。开源社区正利用其零成本抽象能力，系统性重写过去被商业闭源垄断的重型生产力工具，软件基建的“Rust化”已进入深水区。

  • 开源价值回归“实用主义”与“证据驱动”的知识平权。登顶榜首的HowToLiveBetter1以破纪录的热度印证了社区对“反焦虑、重证据”结构化知识的渴求。结合免费域名基建DNSHE-FreeDomains6、安卓底层权限KernelSU8与安全研究库MalwareSourceCode10，开源精神正从纯代码协作延伸至生活指南与底层工具的“实用工具带”。洞察：在AI生成内容泛滥的当下，具备明确成本收益分析、原始出处溯源的“高信噪比”开源项目，正成为开发者与大众对抗信息噪声与不确定性的核心数字资产。

HackerNews 技术热点

1. 技术趋势洞察

AI从“通用对话”向“形式化推理与工程自治”纵深演进
AI数学进展开源14 以破纪录的互动量表明，技术社区的关注重心已彻底转向AI在严密逻辑、定理证明与科学发现中的可验证能力。模型不再仅是内容生成器，而是逐步成为科研协作者。与此同时，GPT-6与智能UI9 与 Docker Agent开源11 揭示了AI向交互层与基础设施层的垂直渗透：前端UI正走向意图驱动的自动生成，而DevOps运维则迈向代理自治。配合 Claude Haiku 5.51 的迭代，高吞吐、低延迟的轻量化推理模型将成为支撑上述场景的底层标配。

Web生态迎来“标准效率拐点”与“反臃肿”极简主义回潮
Chrome支持JPEG XL10 标志着长达数年的图像格式之争尘埃落定，Web媒体传输正式进入高压缩比与高动态范围并重的新阶段。与之形成有趣对照的是，URL即应用工具8 倡导的零依赖理念与 网页动态ASCII艺术17 的创意实践，折射出开发者对重型JS框架与复杂构建链的审美疲劳。声明式、免部署、轻量化的Web原生体验正重新获得工程青睐，形成一股对抗技术栈过度设计的清流。

底层系统Craftsmanship与“物理-数字”精度深度耦合
在AI不断抽象高层业务逻辑的当下，工程师正回归对底层性能的极致打磨。Swift极简内核13、控制流重构逻辑12 与 MySQL新存储引擎15 共同展现了对内存管理、I/O吞吐与代码代数的严谨追求。这种对“精确性”的执着已跨越软件边界，钍核钟正式启振7 与 机器精度演进史18 指向一个明确趋势：计算系统正与原子级时间标准及精密制造深度融合，为下一代高可靠、低容错的自治系统奠定物理基石。

技术史观的回溯与科学严谨性的再确认
软件工程先驱辞世3 登顶热度榜，不仅是社区对阿波罗时代奠基者的致敬，更是AI狂飙期对“系统工程纪律”与“失效安全设计”的集体反思。结合 DNA影像历史新解4 对科学贡献的实证修正，HN社区展现出强烈的历史意识与求真精神：在追逐技术跃迁的同时，不遗忘底层方法论的严谨性，这正是抵御技术泡沫、构建可持续创新的核心锚点。

1. 研究趋势洞察

① 智能体进化范式从“参数微调”转向“Harness（系统外壳）递归自优”
当前Agent研究正经历底层逻辑重构：能力跃升不再依赖基座模型权重的反复更新，而是聚焦于Prompt、控制流、工具链与记忆组成的“Harness”系统级迭代。RRSI4 与 NeoHorse-112 揭示了递归自我改进（RSI）的巨大潜力，但明确指出无约束演化极易导致训练任务过拟合。为此，SkillOpt8 将技能抽象为可稳定更新的“外部文本状态”，实现零推理开销的持续进化；Harness VLA16 则通过记忆引导路由弥补冻结VLA模型的分布外泛化缺陷。核心洞察：未来的Agent竞争将是“架构工程”与“进化算法”的竞争。正则化RSI、课程蒸馏与外部技能优化将取代传统SFT，成为构建自适应、抗过拟合智能体的标准范式。

② 世界模型跨越“像素拟合”，迈向“物理认知与几何先验”原生时代
视频生成模型正从视觉保真度竞赛，快速转向对物理规律与空间一致性的内化。WROP13 首次系统性地为视频模型注入“客体永久性”这一人类核心认知先验；WorldCrafter11 与 GAE15 则分别从隐式3D感知记忆与几何原生潜在空间入手，破解了多视角生成中的结构坍塌难题。配合 GameHorizon17 等多时距交互评测基准，核心洞察：世界模型的评价标准已从“像不像”转变为“懂不懂物理”。具备3D一致性、客体守恒与长程因果推理的“交互式物理模拟器”，将成为具身智能与下一代内容生成的统一底座。

③ 推理效率与端侧部署成为“一等公民”，内存-带宽-算力三角迎来系统级重构
随着模型上下文与参数规模触及硬件瓶颈，服务效率研究从“工程优化”升级为“核心学术前沿”。FreeToken18 针对边缘设备异构特性，提出带宽自适应的MoE路由执行策略；Unlimited OCR14 以参考滑动窗口注意力彻底消除长序列内存线性膨胀；而 SPEED-Bench1 的推出标志着投机解码进入标准化评估阶段。结合经典工作 PagedAttention6，核心洞察：大模型落地正从“云端暴力堆料”转向“端云协同的精打细算”。内存管理、动态路由与长序列注意力优化将深度耦合，推动百亿级多模态模型在个人设备上的原生普及。

  • 智能体架构向“状态持久化与可验证执行”演进：当前Agent研究正突破单轮工具调用瓶颈，转向长程复杂任务的稳健交付。Apodex 1.19与Prime Agent14通过递归子智能体协同、持久计算与故障恢复机制，显著提升了长视野任务的连续性。结合AutoResearch4“生成-证据执行”双阶段设计，表明Agent正从“概率性输出”迈向“抗幻觉、可审计”的自主数字员工范式，工程与科研自动化（如AutoDev3、AgentScope 1.015）已进入可用临界点。

  • 多模态大模型重塑具身控制与空间感知边界：视觉语言模型正从“被动理解者”转变为“通用动作控制器”。Show-Harness12利用离散语义动作直接桥接VLM与机器人底层控制，实现跨平台零样本部署；OpenWAM20则通过模块化预训练提炼世界-动作模型的设计原则。同时，Marigold V213将Diffusion Transformer重构为单步流匹配深度估计器，印证了生成架构向密集预测与物理交互任务迁移的强劲趋势，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）的模态壁垒正在消融。

  • 端侧自适应服务与稀疏化打破算力垄断：大模型部署重心从“云端堆参”转向“端存算协同优化”。FreeToken8提出带宽自适应的MoE调度策略，动态映射异构本地硬件，使个人设备运行开源大模型成为现实。配合SAS18在Softmax内引入连续门控的端到端稀疏注意力机制，以及经典PagedAttention17的KV缓存管理思想，行业正通过算法-系统联合设计实现高吞吐与低延迟的普惠推理，边缘原生AI将成为下一代基础设施标配。

  • 音频基座模型攻克长程连贯与实时记忆瓶颈：语音与音乐生成正摆脱短片段拼接局限，向具备上下文感知与情感连续性的交互模型演进。AuK6统一了指令驱动的语音生成与编辑，YuE2实现了结构对齐的长音乐创作，而VoiceMem11创新的双脑流式记忆架构大幅提升了实时交互中的检索精度与情感个性化。音频模态正加速融入多模态Agent的实时交互闭环，推动人机对话向“类人陪伴”体验跃升。

1. 开源趋势洞察

本期开源生态呈现出**“AI智能体垂直化落地”与“本地优先/隐私计算回归”**的双主线演进特征，技术栈正从“模型能力竞赛”转向“工程化与主权化”深水区：

  • AI Agent 从“通用对话”迈向“工业级工作流”：大模型应用正加速渗透至专业垂直领域，并通过标准化协议打通传统工具链。例如 Unity MCP15 借助 MCP 协议将 AI 助手深度接入 Unity 编辑器，实现资产管理与场景自动化；Waoowaoo14 与 LiveKit Agents11 分别瞄准影视工业级生产与实时语音交互，表明 AI 正在重构高复杂度、多模态的专业工作流。同时，Archify8 和 Fireworks Tech Graph20 等技术绘图工具的集中涌现，印证了“AI 生成可验证架构/流程图”已成为研发提效的新标配，智能体正从“内容生成者”进化为“系统设计协作者”。

  • MCP 与 Agent 技能库生态初具雏形：智能体的能力边界不再依赖单一模型微调，而是转向“技能插件化”与“角色人格化”。Skills18 直接以 .agents 目录形式共享工程师实战技能，而 Ponytail19 则通过注入“资深开发者极简思维”优化 AI 编码策略。这标志着开源社区正在从“提示词工程（Prompt Engineering）”全面转向“智能体技能工程（Agent Skill Engineering）”，可复用、可组合、带角色偏好的 Agent 能力模块将成为下一代开发生态的核心资产。

  • 本地优先（Local-First）与隐私自治成为底层共识：在云端 AI 狂飙的同时，开发者对数据主权、低延迟与无遥测的诉求显著回升。Web-LLM4 实现浏览器端高性能 LLM 推理，配合 OpenLogi3（无账号/无遥测的本地外设驱动）与 ActivityWatch7（隐私优先的时间追踪），勾勒出“端侧智能+本地自治”的技术范式。Rust 语言在 OpenLogi3 与 GPUI Component10 中的高频应用，进一步印证了高性能、内存安全的系统级语言正成为构建本地优先应用的基石。

  • 自助托管（Self-Hosted）与开发者基础设施平民化：ConvertX5、Cloud-Mail13 与 DNSHE-FreeDomains9 的爆发，反映出开发者对“去中心化、低成本、API 驱动”的基础设施需求旺盛。开源正从“提供代码”转向“提供可一键部署的完整服务栈”，大幅降低个人开发者与中小团队的运维与合规门槛。

1. 技术趋势洞察

安全信任链的全面重构与“透明化”防御
从90年代CA密钥破解1到针对完整Linux发行版的Trusting-Trust攻击6，传统基于隐式信任与黑盒防护的安全边界正被系统性击穿。结合LG智能电视隐私泄露10引发的社区震怒，以及开发者对Stuxnet源码复现9的研究热情，安全范式正加速向“白盒审计、攻击面模拟与硬件级隔离”演进。未来，软件供应链的密码学可验证性、IoT设备的默认隐私熔断机制，以及抗量子算法的存量迁移，将成为基础设施的刚性需求。

AI for Science 走向业务纵深，科研范式加速“开源工程化”
WeatherNext 37的发布标志着AI气象预测从实验验证迈入高精度业务化阶段。与此同时，Caltech数学研究黑客松14首创性地将工程冲刺模式引入理论数学，配合交互式生命之树13等开源数据可视化工具，科学研究正打破“实验室孤岛”。AI不仅作为算力加速器，更成为跨学科知识图谱的连接器，推动基础科研向“数据开源、社区协同、算法驱动”的新范式迁移。

反厂商锁定与技术主权的韧性崛起
Broadcom下架VDDK5导致企业虚拟化迁移受阻，再次敲响商业软件生态锁定的警钟。与之形成鲜明对比的是，独立浏览器引擎Ladybird17的稳步推进、TALA语言开源2以及《Simple Is Not Small》19引发的工程哲学共鸣，折射出开发者对“技术可控性”的强烈诉求。而互联网档案馆募捐20的破圈热度则警示行业：公共数字资产与开源生态的可持续性，亟需从“极客热情”转向制度化的资金保障与去中心化架构设计。

1. 研究趋势洞察

基于2026年9月8日前沿文献，AI研究正经历从“参数规模竞赛”向“系统级智能与效率工程”的范式转移，呈现三大核心趋势：

  • 长程Agent从“单轮执行”迈向“状态持久与递归自进化”。传统ReAct框架已触及复杂工作流瓶颈，新一代Agent系统正通过递归子任务分解Prime Agent8、长程状态维护与断点恢复Apodex 1.16以及证据驱动的闭环验证AutoResearch3实现可靠自治。结合小参数模型的循环潜在推理BDH-CQ1表明，“架构记忆与推理拓扑”的优化正取代单纯堆叠上下文窗口，成为突破AGI长程规划与抗幻觉瓶颈的关键路径。
  • 大模型服务进入“边缘原生与内存精细调度”时代。算力成本与延迟约束倒逼底层系统创新。FreeToken通过带宽自适应执行将MoE模型动态映射至异构终端FreeToken4，而Unlimited OCR的参考滑动窗口注意力机制彻底打破长序列内存线性增长魔咒Unlimited OCR17。结合经典KV缓存分页管理思想PagedAttention12的持续演进，可见“计算-内存-带宽”的联合硬件感知调度，已成为大模型普惠化与实时化的基础设施命题。
  • 多模态基础模型呈现“表征统一”与“架构解耦”的双轨演进。一方面，跨模态对齐正走向工业级统一嵌入空间WeMM-Embedding18与语音流式双脑记忆VoiceMem13；另一方面，针对高维复杂任务，模型架构正主动解耦：如文档解析采用视觉-语言粗精分离策略MinerU2.514，具身导航通过统一指向Token激发VLM空间智能LightNav-019，语音合成转向连续Token扩散范式VibeVoice16。这标志着多模态研究已跨越“模态拼接”阶段，进入基于物理特性定制计算图与表征流的新周期。
